4. CONSENT CALENDAR

ACTION: COMMISSIONER BHANDAL MADE A MOTION TO APPROVE CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS 4.A. AND 4.B. COMMISSIONER CANTRELL SECONDED THE MOTION (8-0-2-1; OLIVERIO & YOUNG ABSENT; ESCOBAR ABSTAINED)

a. Review and Approve Action Minutes from November 19, 2025.

b. CP25-020 & ER25-184 (Administrative Hearing): Conditional Use Permit to allow the continued use of an existing wireless facility, consisting of an approximately 77-foot-high monopole and associated ground equipment on an approximately 0.25-gross-acre site located at 419 Lano Street (Froom Judith R Trustee & Et Al, Owner). Council District: 7.

motions.text: a motion to approve Consent Calendar items 4.a. and 4.b.
